title: Make thread rotation a hard evidence gate
notes: Thread rotation now enforces a hard evidence gate in QAController.
Rotation is PASS only when: old_thread_id != None, new_thread_id != None, old_thread_id != new_thread_id, verdict.is_pass == True, and MCP tool invocation is verified.
Failure of any rotation condition records status: FAIL in thread_rotation.json and flags the action as THREAD_ROTATION_GATE_FAILURE.
Also enabled clean StateMachine transition CONFIRMED_BUG -> RUNNING when autonomous repair is disabled.
